$comment: SHARED SOURCE OF TRUTH for the Overlabels DSL. Read by app/Support/Dsl.php (PHP) and resources/js/utils/dsl.ts (TypeScript). Neither runtime may hand-roll a tag regex - see docs/design/overlabels-dsl-spec.md. Character-class fragments below are written so they are byte-identical valid regex in both PCRE and ECMAScript.

lexical.$comment_pipeArgs: Space is permitted INSIDE pipe args for patterns like `date:dd-MM-yyyy HH:mm`, but a pipe may not END on whitespace - otherwise the greedy class eats the space before `??` and the formatter receives an arg with a trailing space (spec D8).
lexical.$comment_blockBody: Any run that cannot swallow the closing ]]]. Permits a single ] inside a condition (spec D7) and still matches across newlines, which the old [^\]]+ also did.

currency.description: Locale-aware currency; defaults to the locale's currency.

duration.description: Seconds to a duration; units overflow into the largest present unit.

login.description: Normalise to a Twitch login (lowercase, no leading @).

$comment_operators: Longest-first. `=` is normalised to `==` at evaluation time; there is no `==` in author-facing syntax.
$comment_namespaceScope: An absent `scope` means every runtime resolves the namespace (overlay renderer, alert renderer, bot resolver). A present `scope` is a DELIBERATE divergence and must list the runtimes that implement it; anywhere else the tag resolves empty per null-over-placeholder. Declare the divergence here rather than letting the runtimes drift apart silently.

c.description: User and template controls, including namespaced service controls.

loop.description: Loop state; valid only inside a foreach body.

rand.description: A random whole number, inline: `rand:0-69`. Both bounds are required and non-negative. Bot-only: an overlay re-renders on every event, so a random tag there would reroll unpredictably - overlays use a number control with config.random plus random_interval, which rerolls on a schedule the author chose.

counter.description: Reads a counter control AND declares that firing this expression increments it by one. The increment happens once per fire in BotExpressionService, never inside the resolver, so the tag itself stays a pure read and preview never mutates. Use `c:<key>` to read the same counter without incrementing. Bot-only: nothing else in the DSL has an effect attached, and a render is not a fire.

$comment_reservedKeys: Keys with meaning independent of any namespace.

raw.description: Dumps the current iteration item as pretty JSON. Brackets are entity-escaped so the dump cannot re-enter tag substitution.
